# Write-free e2e: validate against examples/ + Appendix B fixtures.

# Product minimal CLI — Phase 1 green path.
exec foundry validate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml
stdout 'validate: ok'
stdout 'plan_sha256='
! stderr .
dump_digest stdout

# Minimal TUI — shape-valid; P1 accepts full plan success (TUI in catalog).
exec foundry validate --spec examples/minimal-tui.toml
stdout 'validate: ok'
stdout 'plan_sha256='
! stderr .

# Appendix B private CLI / TUI.
exec foundry validate --spec examples/appendix-b-private-cli.toml
stdout 'validate: ok'
! stderr .
exec foundry validate --spec examples/appendix-b-private-tui.toml
stdout 'validate: ok'
! stderr .

# Public CLI + distribution profile is selectable in Phase 4.
exec foundry validate --spec examples/appendix-b-public-cli.toml
stdout 'validate: ok'
stdout 'plan_sha256='
! stderr .

# Specs exported by d0i (process fixtures mirror examples).
exec foundry validate --spec specs/valid/minimal-cli.toml
stdout 'validate: ok'
! stderr .
exec foundry validate --spec specs/valid/appendix-b-private-cli.toml
stdout 'validate: ok'
! stderr .

# JSON success envelope carries plan_sha256.
exec foundry validate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout '"command":"validate"'
stdout '"plan_sha256"'
! stderr .
